title: Configure
description: Change the look of the site with a few lines in _config.yml.
text: Tokens Tokens restyle the whole site. Each one maps to a CSS variable. slipway: tokens: radius: 0.75rem Languages List each language with its URL prefix. The default language has an empty prefix. slipway: languages: - { code: en, name: English, prefix: "" }

title: Deploy
description: Publish the built site on GitHub Pages.
text: GitHub Pages Push the repository and turn on Pages for the branch. Classic Pages builds the site with the same gem set the theme is tested against. Check before you publish Run the checks, then read the report. npm run check

title: Docs for a Slipway site
description: A documentation site built on the doc layout, with a sidebar, a table of contents, and previous and next links.
text: This site shows the doc layout on a small documentation set: install, configure, write, and deploy.

title: Overview
description: What the guide covers and how the pages are organised.
text: What this guide covers The guide walks through a site from the first install to the first deploy. How the pages are organised Each page is Markdown with a short front matter block. The sidebar comes from _data/navigation.yml, so adding a page to the sidebar is one line. Reading order The previous and next links at the bottom follow the order of the sidebar.

title: Install
description: Add the theme to a site with the gem, a remote theme, or the template.
text: Pick a mode The theme works as a gem, through remote_theme, and after “Use this template”. Add the gem # _config.yml theme: slipway-theme Build bundle exec jekyll build Open _site/index.html to see the result.

title: Write pages
description: Front matter, headings, and code blocks in a documentation page.
text: Front matter Every page needs a title and a description. --- title: My page description: One sentence about the page. layout: doc --- Headings Use ## for sections and ### for subsections. The table of contents is built from them. Code blocks A fenced block gets a copy button when scripts are available, and reads fine without them.
